description: Manages various system-wide lookup values and reference data such as currencies, countries, application types, and lists of partners, contacts, and users for selection purposes.

endpoints.name: GetCurrencies
endpoints.description: Retrieves a list of all available currencies.
example_uses: Get a list of all supported currencies.
What are the available currency codes?
Show me the currency options.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to fetch a comprehensive list of currency codes and names for display or selection.

endpoints.name: GetEligibleEntities
endpoints.description: Retrieves a list of entities that are eligible for certain operations or classifications.
example_uses: List all eligible entities.
Which entities are considered eligible?
Provide the list of eligible organizations.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to retrieve a predefined list of entities that meet specific eligibility criteria.

endpoints.name: GetCountries
endpoints.description: Retrieves a list of all recognized countries.
example_uses: Get a list of all countries.
Which countries are in the system?
Show me the country options.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to fetch a comprehensive list of countries for display or selection, such as for address fields.

endpoints.name: GetApplicationTypes
endpoints.description: Retrieves a list of all defined application types.
example_uses: List all application types.
What are the different types of applications?
Provide the available application categories.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to retrieve a list of predefined application types for categorization or filtering.

endpoints.name: GetPartners
endpoints.description: Retrieves a simplified list of partners, typically for lookup or selection purposes.
example_uses: List all partners for selection.
Which partners are available in the system?
Show me the partner lookup list.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to get a basic list of partners, often used in dropdowns or auto-complete fields where full partner details are not required.

endpoints.name: GetOrganizationUnits
endpoints.description: Retrieves a list of all organizational units within the system.
example_uses: List all organizational units.
What are the available organization units?
Show me the departments and divisions.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to fetch a list of internal organizational structures for assignment or filtering.

endpoints.name: GetLiaisonOffices
endpoints.description: Retrieves a list of all liaison offices.
example_uses: List all liaison offices.
Where are the liaison offices located?
Show me the available liaison offices.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to get a list of liaison offices for selection or informational purposes.

endpoints.name: GetContacts
endpoints.description: Retrieves a simplified list of contacts, typically for lookup or selection purposes.
example_uses: List all contacts for selection.
Which contacts are available in the system?
Show me the contact lookup list.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to get a basic list of contacts, often used in dropdowns or auto-complete fields where full contact details are not required.

endpoints.name: GetUsers
endpoints.description: Retrieves a simplified list of users, typically for lookup or selection purposes.
example_uses: List all users for selection.
Which users are registered in the system?
Show me the user lookup list.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to get a basic list of users, often used in dropdowns or auto-complete fields for assignment or tagging.

endpoints.name: GetGeminiModels
endpoints.description: Retrieves a list of available Gemini AI models.
example_uses: List all Gemini models.
What Gemini models can I use?
Show me the available AI models.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint to fetch a list of supported Gemini AI models for integration or configuration.
